# The Rojas Report — Physician-Owned Hospitals

> POH.rojasreport.com is the physician-owned hospital (POH) division of The Rojas Report, a healthcare intelligence publication by Dutch Rojas. This site covers physician-owned hospital legislation, advocacy, outcomes data, Certificate of Need law reform, and the case for physician ownership in American healthcare.

## About This Site

POH.rojasreport.com is dedicated to comprehensive coverage of physician-owned hospitals — a core advocacy area for founder Dutch Rojas. The site tracks legislation, analyzes outcomes data, profiles successful physician-owned facilities, and provides state-by-state regulatory analysis. Dutch Rojas is one of the most vocal advocates for lifting federal restrictions on physician-owned hospitals and reforming Certificate of Need laws that limit healthcare competition.

## About Dutch Rojas

Dutch Rojas is a healthcare operator, Marine veteran, and founder of MedMerge, a physician-focused infrastructure company. He is co-founder of PhyCap Fund (a physician-led venture capital fund), board member of Physician Led Healthcare for America, and founder of ROJAS MEDIA and The Rojas Report. With 20+ years building and exiting healthcare companies — including a $26.5M exit — Rojas is a leading voice on nonprofit hospital consolidation, Certificate of Need laws, physician-owned hospitals, and physician independence. He invented surgery futures and options contracts.

## Key Topics on This Site

- Physician-owned hospital legislation and federal moratorium status
- State-by-state Certificate of Need (CON) law analysis and reform tracking
- POH outcomes vs. nonprofit hospital outcomes (patient satisfaction, costs, complications)
- Profiles of successful physician-owned hospitals
- Impact of the 2010 ACA Section 6001 moratorium on new POH construction
- Arguments for and against physician hospital ownership
- Physician independence and the fight against hospital consolidation
